name: Duelist Circle 2.0 - card vote result
source: Production card_vote_items / card_votes / card_vote_tiebreaks (read-only export), plus bossg's 52 transferred votes from supabase/manual_deploy/20261012_transfer_owner_votes.sql (a live bossg vote wins over a transferred one). Vote closed; last vote 2026-10-15T19:24:24.918049+00:00.
rule: Per card the majority of those who voted decides; a tie (or no votes) keeps the proposal (no admin tiebreaks existed). 'Allow it' rarity = the most-picked allow_rarity, a rarity tie takes the higher rarity.
owner_decisions: Every card the vote brings back from forbidden is max 1 per deck (limited_1_per_deck) at its voted rarity.
Giant Trunade (Legendary -> Secret Rare) is max 1 per deck.
Mind Drain becomes unlimited (3 per deck) as voted; its rarity stays.
21 Legendaries are accepted; freed Legendary slots are NOT refilled (rank-pool.mjs cuts tiers on the pre-vote statuses, then overlays these results, so no card outside the vote moves).
The 33 tie cards keep the proposal (no overrides).
how_it_is_used: scripts/cardpool/rank-pool.mjs reads this file: before.status is the pre-vote status used for the tier cut, after.rarity overrides the rarity of every changed card. Deck limits come from data/banlists/duelist-circle-proposal.json (updated to match after.status) via build-pool.mjs.
